notes.title: Update #10
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]  Added more checkpoints.
[*]  Many jerky animations are now smoother.
[*]  Jump height adjusted.
[*]  Some enemies are now significantly slower.
[*]  Satellite drone shoots faster and can use special attacks under certain conditions.
[*]  Added the ability to remap gamepad controls.
[*]  Many optimizations, fixes and visual improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update #9
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Level  Dismal Exhibition has been changed to be more beginner-friendly
[*] Jump height slightly increased, fall damage significantly reduced
[*] Some physics fixes
[*] Fixed a crash when trying to change weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Update#8
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added aiming line
[*] Some issues fixed in air hub​​​
[*] Added mouse shooting​
[/list]

notes.title: Update #5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Many visual improvements
[*] Fixed UI elements getting focus erroneously, resulting in unwanted clicks
[*] Fixed excessive damage in dismal exhibition
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Minor handgun and rifle tweaks.
[*]Most platforms no longer block shots. 
[*]Robot spawn doors do not block shots if the enemy is "on top" of the door. 
[*]Minor visual improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]While holding the shot button, the direction of the character is locked. 
[*]Radius of the cartridges has been increased, which makes it easier to shoot at flying targets. 
[*]The character returns to its original state automatically when you release [raise weapon] button/axis. 
[*]The elevators are a little faster now.
[*]Jumping algorithm slightly tweaked
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi, here's the first update.

[list]
 [*]Fixed a bug where a character would get stuck inside Harmony forever.
 [*]When traveling on Harmony, it was not possible to display the menu. 
 [*]Some sprites were displayed distorted.
 [*]Slightly reduced transition time between areas.
[/list]

Have a nice trip
